summary: Pin is a lakeside footpath landing in the gardens; no vehicle way in.
reasons: Footpath only, no vehicle access seen
Dense bush and steep ground around

drivers.seclusion: Very secluded: bush and lake all round, no dwellings mapped or seen.
drivers.access_and_room: Only a narrow paved path reaches the pin; no tyre tracks, vehicles or clearing. Nearest road is about 65 m away.
drivers.traffic: No road traffic at the pin; walkers on gardens paths nearby.
drivers.convention: No sign of people staying overnight; public gardens.

flags: Pin ground is steep: 14% mean grade, 39% max
Low ground near the lake, about 47 to 53 m elevation, waterway 35 m away
Small hut beside the pin, likely a pump or utility building
sun_shade: Under tree canopy, open to the south over the water.
cannot_judge: Whether the path is open to service vehicles
